reason: The connected GitHub API can create pull requests and reliably trigger protected PR CI, but connector-created issue comments did not produce a canonical Actions run pointer.
design: Use workflow_run of the successful Release Architecture Gate as a protected-default-branch transport into the existing canonical Release Set Promotion workflow.
security_invariants: operator code is checked out from protected main
request PR must be Draft, owner-authored, same-repository, based on current protected main, and change exactly one fixed data-only trigger file
operator adapter has no Cloudflare/provider credentials
provider mutation remains solely inside the canonical workflow_dispatch mutation job after native READY and expected-current fences
